Pursuant to the provisions of Regulation 30 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulation, 2015, Ashoka Buildcon Limited (the Company) informs that the Company had submitted bid, for the following Project to Rail Vikas Nigam Limited (RVNL).

Package-3: Supply, Erection, Testing & Commissioning of Electro Mechanical (E&M) System comprising of 33/11kv & 11/0.433kv GIS Substations, HT & LT Cables, DG Sets, Lighting, Ups System, Ventilation Systems & Fire Fighting Systems and other associated works for Tunnel T-13, T-14, T-15 & T-16 under package E-4 Rishikesh Karnprayag New BG Rail Line Project in the State of Uttarakhand (Project).

Further to apprise that the Company has received Letter of Acceptance for the said project.

Pursuant to Regulation 47 of the SEBI (LODR) Regulation, 2015,  please find enclosed copies of newspaper publication published in Free Press Journal (English) and Punyanagari (Vernacular - Marathi) dated August 29, 2026, in connection with notice of 33rd Annual General Meeting to be held on Friday, September 25, 2026 at 12.30 p.m. through Video Conferencing (VC) / Other Audio Visual Means (OAVM).
